primary.text:
Primary
Start recording (press)

Starts speech-to-text recording in the desktop window.

secondary.text:
Secondary
Push to talk (hold)

Hold to dictate (desktop); release to stop.

listening.text:
Secondary
Push to talk (hold)

Hold to dictate (desktop); release to stop.

Press the modifier key you want to hold; Esc cancels. For a shortcut with a letter, use Start recording above.

afterTapSaved.text:
Secondary
Push to talk (hold)
Reset

Hold to dictate (desktop); release to stop.

Press the modifier key you want to hold; Esc cancels. For a shortcut with a letter, use Start recording above.

Every shortcut that uses Control, such as Control+S, will start recording for a moment. Choose Option to avoid this.
